cards.text: Friend, the Sabbath is over, and it's dawn on the first day of the week. Mary Magdalene, one of the women who followed Jesus from Galilee, heads out with the other Mary to see the tomb.
Then suddenly, a GREAT earthquake. Friend, my oven timer DINGS and I jump a foot in the air, gold base and all.

cards.question: A great earthquake shakes everything as the women head to the tomb. What's behind it?

answers.text: An angel of the Lord came down from heaven
The guards were breaking open the seal
The disciples were moving the stone away

cards.question: The angel rolls away the stone from the tomb and then ___ on it.

cards.text: His appearance is like lightning, and his clothes are white as snow. Friend, I can't keep my apron white through ONE batch of dough.

cards.question: The guards posted at the tomb see the angel. What happens to them?

answers.text: They tremble and become like dead men
They draw their swords and charge him
They bow down and worship the angel

cards.text: Then the angel speaks to the women: 'Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.' And the guards? NOBODY is giving them that speech.

cards.question: The women came looking for Jesus. What does the angel tell them about Him?

answers.text: He has risen just as He said
His disciples took His body away
Joseph moved His body in the night

cards.question: The angel invites the women to come and see the place where Jesus lay.

cards.text: Then the angel gives the women a job: go quickly and tell His disciples that He has risen from the dead. Biggest news in history, and it has to go out FAST, while my group chat takes three days to answer a yes or no question.

cards.question: The angel says Jesus is going ahead of the disciples into ___, and there they will see Him.
After an earthquake, an angel whose appearance is like lightning and the news that Jesus has risen, the women hurry away from the tomb in fear and great ___.

cards.text: So they RUN to tell His disciples. Then suddenly, right there on the way, somebody meets them.

cards.question: The women are running to tell the disciples the news. Who suddenly meets them on the way?
Jesus meets the women and says, 'Greetings!' What do they do?

answers.text: They grasp His feet and worship Him
They run back to the empty tomb
They stand back and stay silent

cards.text: Jesus tells them, 'Do not be afraid,' just like the angel did. And He sends a message to the disciples, calling them 'My brothers.'

cards.question: Jesus tells the women that His brothers, the disciples, will see Him in Jerusalem.

cards.text: While the women are on their way, some of the guards go into the city and report to the chief priests all that had happened. Imagine giving THAT report to your boss: 'So... there was an earthquake, a guy who looked like lightning, and then we kind of... lay down.'

cards.question: The chief priests meet with the elders and form a plan. What do they give the soldiers?
The chief priests have paid the soldiers. What story do they tell the soldiers to say about the tomb?

answers.text: His disciples stole Him while we slept
Pilate's men moved Him in the night
Joseph took Him away before dawn

cards.question: The chief priests promise the soldiers that if the report reaches the governor, they'll keep them out of trouble.
The guards turn down the chief priests' money and tell everyone the truth.

cards.text: Matthew says this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day. Asleep the whole time, but you KNOW who did it? That's me waking up from a nap swearing I know exactly who ate the chocolate chips.
Meanwhile, the eleven disciples go to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated. And there He is.

cards.question: When the eleven disciples see Jesus on the mountain, every one of them worships Him with no doubt at all.

cards.text: Friend, if you'd told me back in the junk drawer that I'd end up renewed on a gold base, I'd have doubted TOO. Then Jesus comes right to them and speaks.

cards.question: Jesus comes to the eleven on the mountain and speaks. What does He say has been given to Him?

answers.text: All authority in heaven and on earth
A throne in the city of Jerusalem
Rest from all His work on earth

cards.text: Because of that, Jesus sends them out. Therefore, He says, go and make disciples.

cards.question: Jesus has all authority in heaven and on earth. Who does He send the eleven to make disciples of?
To make disciples, Jesus tells the eleven to ___ them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and ___ them to obey all He commanded.

cards.text: Then Jesus ends with a promise. And it's a BIG one.

cards.question: Jesus sends the eleven out to all nations. How long does He promise to be with them?

answers.text: Always to the end of the age
Until they reach every last nation
Until their work in Galilee is done

findings.problem: The detail that Mary Magdalene was one of the women who followed Jesus from Galilee comes from Matthew 27:55-56, not Matthew 28:1. The card cites only Matthew 28:1, so this outside fact does not carry its supporting reference.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards gives the baker a basis for choosing whether the angel sits, stands or kneels on the stone. All three actions are equally plausible, so the blank quizzes an unseen verb rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'The people of Galilee' is arguably true as far as it goes, because Galilee is included in the commission to all nations. Unlike the explicitly exclusive 'Only the people of Israel,' this option leaves the card open to the argument that it also describes people the eleven are sent to disciple.

rule.text: No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.
